14.t: DISCOUNTED DISABLED OFF CONTIN. PLAY | *ENABLED ON
MUST REMAIN NONE IN "ON" ON POSITION

WHEN THE "DISCOUNTED CONTINUE PLAY" OPTION IS ENABLED, THE PLAYER PAYS THE FULL AMOUNT FOR THE FIRST GAME AND THEN IS ALLOWED TO CONTINUE BY INSERTING ONLY 1 COIN. FOR EXAMPLE, IF THE GAME IS PRICED AT 2 COINS PER 1 PLAY AND THE "DISCOUNTED CONTINUE PLAY" OPTION IS ENABLED, THE PLAYER MUST INSERT 2 COINS FOR HIS FIRST GAME AND THEN ONLY 1 COIN TO CONTINUE HIS GAME.
